title: Keyboard Input
description: Read key presses, holds, and releases using GetKey, GetKeyDown, GetKeyUp, and the KeyCode enum.

slides.title: The Input Class ⌨️
slides.content:
# Reading Direct Keyboard Input

The `Input` class gives you static methods to check the state of any key.

- `Input.GetKey(KeyCode.W)` – true as long as W is held.
- `Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space)` – true **only on the frame** the key is first pressed.
- `Input.GetKeyUp(KeyCode.E)` – true on the frame the key is released.

`KeyCode` is an enum containing all keys (letters, arrows, function keys, etc.).

quizData.question: When is Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space) true?

options.text: Every frame while Space is held
Only on the frame Space is first pressed

quizData.explanation: GetKeyDown fires once on the initial press frame.

quizData.question: Which method would you use to start a charge attack that increases as you hold a key?

options.text: GetKeyDown to start, GetKeyUp to release
GetKey to increase charge, GetKeyUp to fire

quizData.explanation: GetKey lets you read continuous hold to build charge; GetKeyUp fires when released.

slides.title: ⚠️ Frame Timing
slides.content: GetKeyDown and GetKeyUp are only true for one frame. If your game is paused or frame drops, you might miss them. For critical presses, consider using events or the new Input System.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## KeyCode Completion

In your IDE, type `KeyCode.` and IntelliSense shows all keys. Use it instead of remembering key names.
